map_readings.label: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Section 2
map_readings.shows: Map title. The road is drawn as an orange line (legend: Deactivation Prescription) running south along the east side of the Incomappleux River, continuing north as a green line (legend: To Be Surveyed in 2026). A table gives Section 2 as 7266m and Section 2 (to be surveyed) as 6412m.

map_readings.label: WP 2-1 = POC Start of deactivation survey for Section 2
map_readings.shows: Green triangle (legend: Point of Commencement (POC)) on the road where the green to-be-surveyed line meets the orange deactivation prescription line.

map_readings.label: WP 2-6 = BRIDGE/RB/RNSC LEXINGTON CREEK. Remove bridge and restore natural stream channel. Bridge is NOT passable Wet crossing required on high side. 1.5 hrs of machine time expected to create crossing.
map_readings.shows: Red X symbol (legend: Bridge Removal) on the road at the Lexington Creek crossing; no km label.

map_readings.label: WP 2-3 = PFH - start
map_readings.shows: GPS point on the road marking the start of a full pullback section (about a 40m long section of road per the callout).

map_readings.label: WP 2-4 = PFH - end End of full pullback.
map_readings.shows: GPS point on the road marking the end of the full pullback section.

map_readings.label: WP 2-13 = PFL
map_readings.shows: GPS point on the road marking the start of a 3/4 pullback; callout notes safety concerns with rockfall and danger trees above.

map_readings.label: WP 2-14 = PFL End of pullback.
map_readings.shows: GPS point on the road marking the end of the pullback.

map_readings.label: December 12, 2025
map_readings.shows: Date printed in the map information block under the coordinate system and datum.
